subject: Helios Analytics — renewal kickoff, term uplift & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@helios-analytics.com>, Caleb Turner <caleb.turner@helios-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Helios Analytics — renewal kickoff, term uplift & QBR scheduling

Hi Sofia / Caleb,

Thanks for the continued partnership — Helios has been one of our heaviest throughput customers and we want to start the renewal conversation early so there are no surprises. High level: your current commitment ends 2026-06-30; based on recent usage signals (burst patterns in Mar) it looks like you’ll need a modest capacity uplift plus a term change to lock pricing.

Proposed initial plan (60-day runway):
- Week 1 (this week): align on decision makers + procurement requirements
- Week 2: finalize mutual action plan (MAP) and pricing for uplift/burst lanes
- Week 3: formalize term amendment and send DocuSign for signatures
- Week 4: QBR to review capacity/throughput playbook and runbook handoff

To make scheduling easy, can you pick one of these QBR slots?
- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Apr 22, 08:00–09:00 PT
- Fri Apr 23, 14:00–15:00 PT

Attachments: Helios_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (draft MAP), QBR_slot_options.pdf (calendar-friendly slots). I’ve cc’d Rishi (commercial lead) and Monica (CS) — we’ll own pricing and runbook details.

Quick asks for you to confirm in reply:
1) Which QBR slot works and who will join from Helios (ops, procurement, eng)?
2) Any procurement / PO / SOW requirements we should route to legal now?
3) Any hard constraints on uptime or data handling to include in the amendment?

We’ll come prepared with a draft SOW and SOC2 evidence for procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Helios_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx] [Attachment: QBR_slot_options.pdf]

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@helios-analytics.com>

Cc: Caleb Turner <caleb.turner@helios-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Helios Analytics — renewal kickoff, term uplift & QBR scheduling

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan. We’d like to move forward on a 12‑month term (annual) with an initial capacity uplift and the option to burst. A few notes from our side:

- Thu Apr 22, 08:00–09:00 PT works best for our team (Caleb and I). Please hold that slot.
- Procurement requires a draft SOW and any vendor security artifacts before we raise a PO — specifically SOC2 Type II report and data retention details.
- Can you outline pricing for the uplift vs. burst (hourly burst versus committed tokens)? We need a simple comparison table in the MAP.
- I’ve CC’d our procurement mailbox (procure@helios-analytics.com) so they can chime in on PO timelines.

We’ll plan to have Caleb (platform lead) and Leila from procurement on the QBR. If you can add an operations/throughput readout to the agenda (we want to validate sustained qps expectations), that would be great.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform | Helios Analytics
sofia.ramos@helios-analytics.com

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helios Analytics — renewal kickoff, term uplift & QBR scheduling

Thanks Sofia — great, we’ll hold Thu Apr 22, 08:00–09:00 PT as a provisional QBR.

Next internal owners / actions:
- Rishi (commercial) -> finalize uplift vs burst pricing table and send updated MAP by Tue Apr 13 EOD
- Monica (CS) -> prepare throughput runbook + short architecture readout (5 slides) for the QBR
- Kimberly (AE) -> route draft SOW and DocuSign term amendment to procurement; include our standard SOC2 bundle link

Monica — can you include typical warm‑up times for burst lanes and a short note on cache priming strategies? Sofia asked for sustained qps assumptions; a slide with historical 95th percentile token/sec over the last 3 months should be perfect.

Sofia / Caleb — quick clarifications for procurement: our SOC2 Type II report and data-handling summary are in the security bundle (link below). If the procurement team can confirm PO lead time (days to issue after SOW), we’ll time the DocuSign.

Security bundle: https://redwood.app/security/Helios-bundle-HL-2026-047
HubSpot deal: https://redwood.app/hubspot/HL-2026-047

We’ll aim to have a redline and pricing table ready by Tue Apr 13 to keep the 60-day runway intact.

-Rishi
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Kimberly / Rishi — confirmed. Thu Apr 22, 08:00–09:00 PT is good for our team. Attending: me (platform lead), Sofia (Head of Platform), Leila (procurement), and Amir (SRE).

A couple of asks for the QBR agenda so we can prep on our side:
- 15m throughput readout (Monica) with 95th percentile qps and an explanation of cache priming behavior
- 10m capacity plan and pricing comparison: committed uplift vs burst billing
- 10m SLOs/SLA / uptime and where fallback to smaller models occurs

Procurement note: Leila will need the SOW + redline and the SOC2 bundle link to start the PO review. Her timeline is typically 7–10 business days from receipt of docs.

Thanks — Caleb
Caleb Turner
Platform Lead | Helios Analytics
caleb.turner@helios-analytics.com

Hi team — thanks for the quick responses and for locking the slot. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) I’ve created a provisional calendar event and shared a Google Meet (link included in the calendar). Please accept when you have a minute: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example
2) DocuSign: I’ve uploaded the term amendment (redline) to DocuSign. Leila / procurement, you should get an invite; powerform link: https://na3.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=example
3) Rishi will circulate an updated MAP with a pricing table (committed uplift vs burst).
4) Monica will attach the 5-slide throughput readout to the calendar event and include warm‑up and cache notes.

Attachments: term_change_redline_v1.docx (redline), updated_MAP_placeholder.xlsx (will be replaced with final by Tue EOD).

If procurement confirms 7–10 business days to issue a PO, we should be in good shape to complete signatures before the current term ends 2026-06-30.

Looking forward to the QBR.

Best,
Kimberly Park
